title: Devanity repository rules
description: One declaration per repository, compiled into three surfaces: the context the kernel receives per path, the PreToolUse/Stop guards, and the reference CI job (SPEC §7.1). Absent file: every path is `normal`, guards record and never block.

paths.description: Glob (relative to the repository root; `**` crosses directories) → rule. The most specific matching glob wins; ties go to the last declared.

check.description: Command the Stop oracle and the CI job run for a change under this path.

purpose.description: One line: what this path is. Injected into every session with the path's invariants (the repository map, SPEC §0.4).

invariants.description: What never changes under this path. Owners come from CODEOWNERS, never from here.

tests.description: Globs naming test files (overlaid on HEAD by the Stop oracle). Default: test_*, *_test.*, *.test.*, *.spec.*, tests/**.

commands.description: Bash command patterns (regular expressions) that need at least the named authority; checked by the PreToolUse guard on top of the built-in list.

autonomy.description: Envelope for unattended sessions (SPEC §7.3). `merge` and `deploy` are never grantable here.
